paragraphs: IDSS sells a cloud-based CRM for the travel and tourism industry. The company says more than 170 destinations around the world run their organizations on the product, called iDSS Cyclone.

It is described as the first web-based CRM platform in the destination marketing sector, with a single codebase that lets new features reach every user each month. Coverage runs from sales, membership and services through marketing and finance. Data is held in one organization-wide view rather than split by department or role.

The platform was ideated and developed by a destination marketing organization, according to the site. The company credits its technology stack for accelerated development timelines. Additional software service options and technical support are offered under the Tempest name. The footer lists a phone number alongside a tempest.im address.

quote.text: More than 170 destinations around the world choose to power their organizations with iDSS Cyclone
